test_title: PYST 27 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:

 The novel's protagonist is portrayed as a _______ hero, flawed yet striving for redemption.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fallible**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**fallible**" means capable of making mistakes or being wrong, which fits the description of a flawed hero striving for redemption.
 
• The sentence describes the protagonist as imperfect yet attempting to redeem themselves, which aligns with the meaning of "**fallible**."
